learnerStatement: Simulated learner. This review finds problems; it is not evidence that anyone learned.
learnerBoundary: Everyday numeracy, simple charts, comparing numbers and familiar household objects; no domain-specific theory assumed.

observations.prediction: Selected gamma for radiation stopped by paper and locked it in.
observations.exploration: Initial no-shield screenshot showed each100 per second. Paper showed alpha0,beta95,gamma100. Aluminium3 mm showed alpha0,beta0,gamma95. Lead5 cm showed alpha0,beta0,gamma2. Reveal unlocked after all three shields.
observations.reveal: Corrected alpha. Explains heavy charged helium nucleus losing energy early, beta needing aluminium and neutral gamma penetrating with2 per100 left after lead.
observations.visual: Inline screenshots inspected at initial,paper,aluminium,lead. Pink beam continuation thickness tracks transmitted counts, barrier labelled by material/thickness, species and count labels legible. Trust8/8 ignored.
observations.isolation: No-history evaluation preview banner present. Visible trust count ignored.
observations.reference: Own CUA tab 543884122 snapshots and inspected inline screenshot; no screenshot file saved.

prediction.reason: Clear commitment but unexplained radiation names require prior chemistry knowledge to make more than a guess.
prediction.evidence: Alpha/beta/gamma alternatives; stage names particles but no mechanism before lock.

interaction.reason: Shield contrasts reveal different attenuation with numeric outputs.

payoff.reason: Connects observed shielding to particle charge/type and gamma residual.
payoff.evidence: Heavy charged alpha versus neutral gamma explanation.

clarity.reason: Material/thickness buttons,beam widths and transmitted counts are legible.
clarity.evidence: Four inspected screenshots and successful sequence.

transfer.reason: Charge/penetration principle offered without new application or applicability limits by radiation energy.
transfer.evidence: Heavy charged easy to stop; neutral gamma goes deep.

accessibility.evidence: Keyboard, focus, contrast audit, phone, zoom/reflow and motion unknown.

surprise.reason: Gamma prediction reversed and lead still leaves nonzero gamma.

visualExplanation.reason: Beam continuations carry attenuation across three material contrasts.

playfulness.reason: Shield buttons enable reversible material comparisons.

depth.reason: Species,charge and incomplete attenuation linked across materials.

complexity.reason: Compares three particle types across three shields with supported counts.
complexity.conceptualDemand: Relates radiation identity and charge to penetration.

whyCool: Changing paper to aluminium removes the beta beam, while even thick lead leaves a thin gamma line and a nonzero count.
caveat: Fixed approximate counts do not expose radiation-energy dependence or a fresh shielding problem.
